meaning.en: To be extremely expensive or require a very large amount of money.
meaning.zh: 非常昂貴；需要花費一大筆錢；價錢高得驚人。

register.summaryZh: cost the earth 屬於非正式而帶有強調作用的表達，特別適合用於：
register.formalEn: In formal financial reports, precise wording such as extremely expensive, financially unworkable or estimated to cost £500,000 may be clearer.
register.formalZh: 在正式財務報告中，使用 extremely expensive、financially unworkable 或列明實際預計金額，通常會更清楚。

benefits.titleEn: It Emphasises an Extremely High Price
benefits.en: The idiomatic version expresses stronger surprise or criticism.
benefits.zh: 慣用版本帶有更強烈的驚訝或批評語氣。

benefits.en: Replacing the roof cost the earth.
benefits.zh: 它可以用較短的方式表達「需要支付一筆極為龐大的金額」。

benefits.en: A cup of coffee in that hotel costs the earth.
benefits.zh: 這種說法能自然表達說話者認為價格過高或不合理。

benefits.titleZh: 否定形式可以令人安心
benefits.en: A stylish home does not have to cost the earth.
benefits.zh: 這個句子說明，即使預算有限，仍然可以作出理想的選擇。

benefits.en: The project may cost the earth if we keep adding new features.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以警告別人，某項計劃可能變得難以負擔。

benefits.en: The first option cost the earth, whereas the second was reasonably priced. The idiom is not automatically better than stating an exact price. When precision matters, a real figure is clearer. Model Examples Source: Answer: Model 2: Negative Form Source: Answer: Model 3: Optional Extension Source: Answer: The core relationship is cost the earth. Us and to replace all the windows provide additional information.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以清楚對比昂貴和可以負擔的選項。 慣用語並非一定比實際金額更好。 需要精確資料時，列出真正價錢會更清楚。 Model Examples 示範例子 Model 1: Direct Form 新梳化貴得難以置信。 新梳化貴得驚人。 示範二：否定形式你不用花費一大筆錢，也可以享受家庭旅行。 家庭旅行不一定要花費一大筆錢。 示範三：可選延伸部分更換所有窗戶令我們需要支付一筆巨款。 更換所有窗戶令我們花費了一大筆錢。 核心關係是 cost the earth。 us 和 to replace all the windows 只是提供額外資料。

origin.statusEn: Exact Origin Unknown; Probable Gradual Development
origin.statusZh: 確切來源不明；很可能是逐漸形成

history.en: Today, cost the earth is an informal and emphatic way of saying that something is extremely expensive.
history.zh: 今天，cost the earth 是一種非正式而帶有強調作用的說法，表示某件事情價格極為高昂。

origin.memoryEn: Imagine a price so high that even all the money in the world would not seem enough.
origin.memoryZh: 想像價錢高得彷彿用盡世上所有金錢仍然不夠。

rules.titleEn: Use “Costs” with a Singular Present Subject
rules.titleZh: 規則二：現在式單數主語使用 costs
rules.en: The second sentence is possible only when the intended time is past.
rules.zh: 只有在表達過去時間時，The room cost the earth 才正確。

rules.en: The incorrect answer changes a possibility into a completed fact.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案把可能性改成已完成的事實。

rules.titleEn: Use the Idiom Only for a Very High Price
rules.titleZh: 規則六：只用於極高價格
rules.en: Use the Idiom Only for a Very High Price

rules.zh: 花費整個地球花費一大筆錢貴得驚人價錢極為高昂

rules.titleZh: 規則八：人物位置是可選的
rules.en: Both are complete. Us merely identifies who paid.
rules.zh: 兩句都完整。 us 只是補充指出誰承擔費用。

rules.titleZh: 規則九：後接不定詞是可選的
rules.en: The second sentence gives more information, but to replace the roof is not part of the idiom.
rules.zh: 第二句提供更多資料，但 to replace the roof 並不是慣用語的一部分。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Force One Grammar Position
rules.titleZh: 規則十：不要強迫使用單一句法位置
rules.en: A strong exercise must train these different grammatical routes.
rules.zh: 優質練習必須訓練以上不同句法途徑，而不是反覆使用同一個位置。
